app.title: Iowa State - International Undergraduate Application Information

excel.title: Iowa State - International Student Excellence Award

test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT are not required for international applicants educated abroad, but a 1200+ SAT or 25+ ACT composite automatically counts as meeting the 3.0 GPA requirement, and SAT/ACT is required to qualify for the automatic Excellence awards (President's and Dean's).

requirements.notes: Formula-style admission: international first-years need a high school GPA equivalent to 3.0/4.0 (or SAT 1200+/ACT 25+) plus core courses (4 English, 3 math incl. algebra and geometry, 3 science incl. 2 lab, 2 social studies). Rolling admission with no closing date; apply 6-8 weeks before needed for the I-20/visa. No essays, recommendations or merit certificates are required. $65 fee, no waiver. Bank statement or sponsor letter required ($52,000 for most majors, $54,300 for Design and Animal Enterprise and Innovation per the requirements page; another Iowa State page shows $49,300). Official English test results may arrive up to 30 days after the deadline.

deadlines.label: International Merit Scholarship priority deadline (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: Priority date for the OneApp International Merit Scholarship application (page prints no year; taken as the fall 2027 cycle) (Award of Achievement up to $40,000; Award of Distinction up to $16,000). Admission itself is rolling with no application closing date.

deadlines.label: Accept offer of admission (fall); final International Merit Scholarship date
deadlines.notes: Accepting by May 1 is required for the automatic International Student Excellence Award and for the Merit Scholarship.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived for native English speakers residing in a country where English is a primary official language, graduates of U.S. high schools, and those with a B or higher in the equivalent of Iowa State's English 1500 or 2500 at an accredited U.S. college. Alternatives to a test: SAT EBRW 460, ACT English 19, IB English 5, AP English Language 3 or Literature 4, IGCSE/O-Level D in First Language English or C in ESL. IELTS One Skill Retake and TOEFL MyBest scores are not accepted. No conditional admission or ESL pathway program is described on the international admissions pages reviewed.

english.notes: 71 iBT with at least 17 on Speaking and Writing (exams taken before 2026-01-21).
4.0 with a minimum band of 3.5 on the 6.0 scale (exams from 2026-01-21).
6.0 overall with all subscores 5.5 or above; One Skill Retake not accepted.
Minimum Duolingo English Test score is 105.

aid.notes: Automatic International Student Excellence Award for admitted first-years, no separate application: President's $56,000 total ($14,000/yr, needs SAT/ACT), Dean's $48,000 ($12,000/yr, needs SAT/ACT), Innovator's $40,000 ($10,000/yr, GPA 3.70+, no test needed), Launchpad $24,000 ($6,000/yr, GPA 3.50-3.69, no test needed); up to 8 semesters. Cannot be combined with the competitive International Merit Scholarship (OneApp; up to $40,000 or $16,000). Must accept the offer by May 1.
